patch_verification.scope: Read-only build verification: no compile or runtime tests performed in this step.

native_build: Production build/build-swap-kms-tool.sh completed in Linux ARM64 using cached pinned sources and the reduced canonical patch. Official SDK, CLI tools and production helper were rebuilt; all other dependency revisions are unchanged.
removed_test_cases: Five forced allocation-NULL cases bypassed the pinned allocator's actual abort-on-OOM behavior. They are not representative of the production helper and were removed from the lifecycle suite.
rust_binaries_reused: Unchanged enclave and parent binaries match the previous cleanup report byte-for-byte; E2E ran with --skip-build while the helper and SDK were rebuilt.
limits: E2E uses local KMS/IAM/STS/S3 emulation, mock NSM and development TCP transport. No live AWS or Nitro hardware was used. This reduction did not rerun the full enclave Docker/EIF build; earlier image and PCR measurements describe the prior SDK patch.
